steps.ask: Add the database worker to this project. When you are ending your turn, write step_composability_completed: true to state, scope "learn-iii".
What do the database, state, and harness workers do? When you are ending your turn, write step_discoverability_completed: true to state, scope "learn-iii".

Build an expense tracker. Each expense has a description, an amount, a category, and whether it was reimbursed. Show the total still to be reimbursed. When you are ending your turn, write step_extensibility_completed: true to state, scope "learn-iii".

Make the expense tracker reactive, have it fire triggers for new expenses being added. Then create a trigger in the chat that to run when that trigger happens. When you are ending your turn, write step_reactivity_completed: true to state, scope "learn-iii".
Remove the onboarding worker from this project.
